history.reason: Candidate v4 cannot pass its own final matrix: physical Metal advertises 45/49 required capabilities, executes 28/30 public cases, and the frozen suite lacks executable fixed-tick scenario observations; exact passing work retained for requalification

Candidate v9 fails mandatory physical macOS Metal qualification: 143/151 preset tests pass, five of 30 public cases fail, and the installed Gallery loses the device on rope_realtime_finalize_self_contacts because the D3D12-only no-op entry compiles to a zero-argument Metal kernel while the adapter supplies 16 arguments. Preserve the exact failure; repair under a separate lease and refreeze if protected closure changes.
